description: Call search_skills before starting any coding, deployment, debugging, design or prompt-writing task. Searches TheSkillVault, a library of vibe-coding skills and prompts. Returns names + one-line descriptions only; call get_skill to load the full instructions of the best match before doing the task.

model.description: Optional AI model family filter: chatgpt (ChatGPT), claude (Claude), gemini (Gemini), grok (Grok), llama (Llama), deepseek (DeepSeek), mistral (Mistral), qwen (Qwen), kimi (Kimi K). Skills written for "any" AI match every family.

proven.description: Optional. true limits results to skills marked works-on-5-models: the latest logged result is a pass on 5+ AI families within 365 days.

query.description: What the user is trying to do, in plain words

name: search_skills
title: Search skills
